get.description: Retrieve a specific revision of a site page by providing the page's object ID and the revision ID. This endpoint is useful for accessing historical versions of a page for review or restoration purposes.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the site page whose revision is being retrieved.

parameters.name: revisionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the specific revision of the site page to retrieve.

post.description: Restore a specific revision of a site page in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to revert a site page to a previous state using the revision ID. It is useful for recovering content that was accidentally changed or deleted.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the site page to restore.

parameters.name: revisionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the revision to restore.

post.description: Restore a specific revision of a site page to a draft state. This operation allows you to revert a site page to a previous version, which can be useful for undoing changes or recovering content. The page identified by the objectId will be updated to reflect the content of the specified revisionId.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the site page to be restored.

parameters.name: revisionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the revision to restore to draft. This must be an integer.
